title: 暖暖躺好晚安
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE original full-bleed vertical 9:16 watercolor story illustration for one locked narration shot. Use every input according to its explicitly labelled role; preserve the existing named identities, not just their species. Input 1: identity for 皮皮 (pipi), preserve exactly: 暖灰毛、圆脸、粉色小鼻、自然下垂长耳；身份不随活动和换装变化。 Input 2: clothing only for 皮皮: 换装表右：原深蓝星星睡帽和黄色帽球，保留原兔体型；玩偶和毛毯是另行配置的场景道具。
Visible characters: 皮皮 (pipi). Exact total number of visible characters: 1. Do not draw extra background animals. Standing body-height ratios (not ear or tail tips): 皮皮 1.0. Pipi wears ONLY the RIGHT bedtime star cap, navy with pale yellow stars and yellow pompom. No overalls, raincoat, backpack or shoes in bed. Yellow blanket and orange carrot toy with dark green leaves are scene props, not identity changes. Scene continuity: 最后一幅安睡画面：皮皮抱着胡萝卜玩偶，在暖黄被窝中舒适入睡，画面适合晚安尾声。
The SINGLE visual moment and framing: 宁静、舒适，不出现文字；最后约8秒保持这个安睡状态。
Emotional performance for this exact beat: 按本镜台词设计眉眼、视线、耳姿和姿势；温柔克制，不复制默认困倦/忧郁脸。
Mandatory pose/prop state (overrides neutral model-sheet poses): 单幅竖屏水彩，无文字/气泡/拼贴/额外角色；字幕区留低细节；围巾、枝杈、芽苞及角色位置按continuity.json保持一致。
Style: hand-painted gentle watercolor on fine warm paper, muted natural hues, soft edges and rounded shapes, quiet storybook mood, no glossy 3D or photorealism. Daylight scenes use soft greens and warm daylight, not bedroom amber tint. Night scenes use soft warm lamplight and muted gray-blue windows. Composition: full-bleed vertical 9:16. Keep all important faces, hands, feet, biscuits, fabric folds and other story actions in the upper 68% of the image. Bottom 32% is low-detail negative space for later subtitles, with no crucial objects there. Make the specified story state visually understandable. Text: NONE. No words, labels, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, panels, frames or collage. Do not reproduce model sheets, multiple versions of a character, or wardrobe lineups. Each named character appears exactly once. This is a new single coherent scene, not a copy of the references. No motion streaks or implied camera zoom. Never turn a metaphor into a real transformation: yellow blankets remain fabric, imagined grassy softness is not actual grass growing in bed. No new story events. 
Continuity lock for this episode: the only scarf is one soft pale butter-yellow knitted scarf with clear chunky stitches and fringed ends, matching the scarf reference. It is never duplicated. The porch is one quiet autumn cottage yard with the same low shrub branch and tiny intact buds; twilight becomes blue-gray, indoors a warm wooden entry and simple wooden coat rack. Pipi is the same small tan long-eared rabbit from reference. No extra animals, letters, symbols, or change of location except the explicitly narrated move indoors. Bedtime scene after bath: Pipi wears starry sleep cap and is under one yellow blanket, with exactly one orange carrot plush. The scarf stays inside on the entry rack, out of bed. Exactly one carrot toy and one Pipi. Relaxed bedtime, same room and character anatomy.
